name: 55011 · Cedar, MN
findings: ZIP 55011 (Cedar) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55011 (Cedar) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 55011 (Cedar) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
